lines.zh: 我从坟土里爬出，土从指缝漏下。
lines.en: I climb out of grave soil, dirt slipping through my fingers.

lines.zh: 夜色是我的路，白天是火。
lines.en: Night is my road; daylight is fire.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿，膝盖里像塞了石子。
lines.en: I lurch step by step, pebbles grinding in my knees.

lines.zh: 军团在墓园列队，我走在第二排。
lines.en: The legion forms in the graveyard; I walk in the second row.

lines.zh: 腐草在我脚下碎成粉。
lines.en: Rotting grass crumbles to powder under my feet.

lines.zh: 我拖着腿走，身后的土路很长。
lines.en: I drag my leg; the dirt path behind me is long.

lines.zh: 风吹过肋骨，发出空心的声音。
lines.en: Wind passes my ribs and makes a hollow sound.

lines.zh: 我闻着血味，绕过一排墓碑。
lines.en: Following the smell of blood, I pass a row of graves.

lines.zh: 二三十只同行，脚步像雨点。
lines.en: Thirty of us walk together, footsteps like rain.

lines.zh: 太阳一露头，我就得找影子。
lines.en: The moment the sun shows, I must find shadow.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草叶都发黄。
lines.en: Where I walk, the grass turns yellow.

lines.zh: 走得不快，可队伍不会散。
lines.en: Slow steps, but the column does not scatter.

lines.zh: 我站在坟前，不记得下面是谁。
lines.en: I stand at a grave and forget who lies below.

lines.zh: 月光照着我，我一点也不冷。
lines.en: Moonlight falls on me and I feel no cold.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，只出来一点土气。
lines.en: I open my mouth and only grave dust comes out.

lines.zh: 军团散在墓园里，各自发呆。
lines.en: The legion scatters through the graveyard, each lost in thought.

lines.zh: 我数着远处的火把，一根两根。
lines.en: I count distant torches, one, then two.

lines.zh: 蛆在我肩头爬，我不赶它。
lines.en: Maggots crawl on my shoulder; I let them stay.

lines.zh: 风停了，我的骨头也静了。
lines.en: The wind stops, and my bones go still.

lines.zh: 我低低地哼，调子早就忘了。
lines.en: I hum low, the tune long forgotten.

lines.zh: 这块碑的字磨平了，我摸着。
lines.en: The name is worn off this stone; I trace it.

lines.zh: 白天太阳烫，土里凉快些。
lines.en: The sun stings by day; the soil is cooler.

lines.zh: 我眼窝里没有眼，却看得见你。
lines.en: No eyes in my sockets, yet I see you.

lines.zh: 你身上有活人的热，很刺眼。
lines.en: The warmth of the living on you is glaring.

lines.zh: 我歪着脖子，听你心跳多快。
lines.en: I tilt my neck and listen to how fast your heart goes.

lines.zh: 你举剑，我往前挪了半步。
lines.en: You raise your sword; I shuffle half a step forward.

lines.zh: 我认得出踩过坟土的这种靴子。
lines.en: I know boots that have trampled grave soil.

lines.zh: 你退，我就多看一会儿。
lines.en: You retreat, so I watch a little longer.

lines.zh: 我的下巴掉了半块，还挂着。
lines.en: Half my jaw has come loose and still hangs.

lines.zh: 你不敢看我，可我看得见你。
lines.en: You will not look at me; I see you regardless.

lines.zh: 军团里所有眼睛都转向你。
lines.en: Every eye in the legion turns to you.

lines.zh: 你身上的伤，我隔着十步就闻到。
lines.en: I smell your wound from ten paces off.

lines.zh: 剑砍进肋骨，我漏了一口气。
lines.en: The sword bites my ribs and I leak a breath.

lines.zh: 我的血是黑的，滴在土里就不见。
lines.en: My blood is black and vanishes into the soil.

lines.zh: 你打断我一根骨头，我用另一根站。
lines.en: You break one bone; I stand on another.

lines.zh: 疼已经隔了一层，像从别处传来。
lines.en: Pain is muffled now, as if coming from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我倒下，又被同伴拖起来。
lines.en: I fall, and a flockmate drags me upright.

lines.zh: 这一剑砍掉了我的耳朵，我不找了。
lines.en: The blade takes my ear; I do not look for it.

lines.zh: 护甲挡住一半，剩下一半我忍着。
lines.en: The armor stops half; I endure the other half.

lines.zh: 我的下巴彻底掉了，说话更难。
lines.en: My jaw finally drops off; speech is harder now.

lines.zh: 你砍得很准，可我不止一只。
lines.en: Your cuts are precise, but I am not just one.

lines.zh: 等我倒下，土会把我收回去。
lines.en: When I fall, the soil will take me back.

lines.zh: 你举着面包，我只闻到你的血。
lines.en: You hold out bread; I only smell your blood.

lines.zh: 坟土比面包更合我的胃口。
lines.en: Grave soil suits my appetite better than bread.

lines.zh: 你把腐肉扔下，我连看都不看。
lines.en: You toss rotten flesh down; I do not even look.

lines.zh: 让我靠近的不是饭，是你还在喘气。
lines.en: What draws me closer is not a meal but your breathing.

lines.zh: 你给我苹果，我伸手去够你的手腕。
lines.en: You offer an apple; I reach for your wrist.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，像围着刚埋的东西。
lines.en: I circle you like something freshly buried.

lines.zh: 你退后三步，我前进三步。
lines.en: You back away three steps; I take three.

lines.zh: 同伴在后面等着，它们也饿。
lines.en: The others wait behind; they are hungry too.

lines.zh: 面包掉在地上，被我的脚踩烂。
lines.en: The bread falls and my foot crushes it.

lines.zh: 我张手不是要接，是要抓。
lines.en: My open hand is not for taking but for grabbing.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，骨头响得比你还大声。
lines.en: You bump me and my bones rattle louder than you.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，脚踝还在原地转。
lines.en: I step back and my ankle keeps turning in place.

lines.zh: 活人的肩膀撞在肋骨上，疼的是你。
lines.en: A living shoulder against ribs; the ache is yours.

lines.zh: 我被推得歪倒，又慢慢直起来。
lines.en: I am shoved over and rise up slowly.

lines.zh: 腐肉的味道在碰撞里散开。
lines.en: The smell of rot spreads when we collide.

lines.zh: 你不肯让路，我也不打算让。
lines.en: You will not yield, and neither will I.

lines.zh: 我抓了你一把，指甲留了印。
lines.en: I swipe once and leave nail marks.

lines.zh: 军团挤过来，把你围在中间。
lines.en: The legion crowds in and closes around you.

lines.zh: 我撞开墓碑，碑倒了也不管。
lines.en: I knock a headstone down and do not care.

lines.zh: 贴着你的盔甲，我听见自己牙齿响。
lines.en: Against your armor I hear my own teeth chatter.

lines.zh: 死人不结伴，我们只是同批埋的。
lines.en: The dead do not pair; we were merely buried together.

lines.zh: 坟土里没有婚礼，只有队列。
lines.en: No weddings in grave soil, only ranks.

lines.zh: 它和我并肩，是因为路一样。
lines.en: It walks beside me because our road is the same.

lines.zh: 没有谁属于谁，军团只属于夜。
lines.en: No one owns anyone; the legion belongs to night.

lines.zh: 同一个坑里爬出来，算亲戚吗。
lines.en: We crawled from one pit; does that make us kin?

lines.zh: 它掉了一只手，我捡起来给它。
lines.en: It dropped a hand; I pick it up and return it.

lines.zh: 并肩站着，我们想的是同一件事。
lines.en: Standing together, we think the same thought.

lines.zh: 土里的东西不分公母，只分快慢。
lines.en: Things in the soil are not male or female, only fast or slow.

lines.zh: 我们互相扶着，只为了走得久些。
lines.en: We hold each other up only to last longer.

lines.zh: 等天亮了，我们就一起烧。
lines.en: When day comes, we burn together.

lines.zh: 地上那把骨头，我拿起来看看。
lines.en: A bone on the ground; I pick it up to look.

lines.zh: 我捡起掉落的护甲，穿不上。
lines.en: I pick up dropped armor and cannot wear it.

lines.zh: 这块腐肉我留着，路上吃。
lines.en: I keep this rotten flesh to eat on the way.

lines.zh: 我把掉落的剑插进坟里。
lines.en: I push the dropped sword into the grave soil.

lines.zh: 堕落精华落在土上，我认得它。
lines.en: Corrupted essence falls on the soil; I know it.

lines.zh: 我拾起半块颅骨，跟自己的比。
lines.en: I pick up half a skull and compare it with mine.

lines.zh: 口袋破了，东西又从指缝掉了。
lines.en: My pocket is torn; what I gather slips through my fingers.

lines.zh: 你的盾牌太重，我拖着走。
lines.en: Your shield is heavy; I drag it along.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很慢，弯腰要响半天。
lines.en: I gather slowly; bending over takes an age of creaking.

lines.zh: 拿走就不还，死人不懂归还。
lines.en: Once taken, never returned; the dead do not give back.

lines.zh: 你踩断一根树枝，军团都听见了。
lines.en: You snap a twig; the whole legion hears it.

lines.zh: 火光从你手里漏出来，我看见了。
lines.en: Light leaks from your hand; I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，骨架一节节转过来。
lines.en: I raise my head, vertebra by vertebra.

lines.zh: 活人的气味在墓园里太明显。
lines.en: The smell of the living is obvious in a graveyard.

lines.zh: 二十只一起停下，同时看向你。
lines.en: Twenty of us halt and look at you at once.

lines.zh: 亡魂先飘过去，我们从地面跟上。
lines.en: The wraiths drift ahead; we follow on the ground.

lines.zh: 你踏进坟圈子，就算选好了。
lines.en: You stepped inside the graves; that settles it.

lines.zh: 我伸出手，指的方向就是你的胸口。
lines.en: I reach out, and my finger points at your chest.

lines.zh: 太阳快出来了，得在你走前解决。
lines.en: The sun is rising; this must end before you leave.

lines.zh: 行尸走肉不是称号，是我们给的。
lines.en: Walking Dead is no title; it is what we hand out.

lines.zh: 你退到墓碑后，我们绕过去。
lines.en: You hide behind a headstone; we go around it.

lines.zh: 军团安静了，那就是要动了。
lines.en: The legion falls silent; that means we move.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁，我不怕铁。
lines.en: You carry iron; I do not fear iron.

lines.zh: 目标定了，就是你手里那盏灯。
lines.en: The target is set: the lantern in your hand.

lines.zh: 石棺的盖子被我们自己推开了。
lines.en: We pushed the lid off the stone coffin ourselves.

lines.zh: 我从左边绕，右边有两只在等。
lines.en: I come round the left; two wait on the right.

lines.zh: 你数得清我们，却数不清退路。
lines.en: You can count us, not your exits.

lines.zh: 每只都比你慢，可我们没有停。
lines.en: Each of us is slower than you, yet none of us stops.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里会先软。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they give out first.

lines.zh: 夜色只剩一点，我抓紧这点黑。
lines.en: Only a little night remains; I hold on to that dark.

lines.zh: 你砍倒一只，后面还有二十九只。
lines.en: You cut one down; twenty-nine remain behind.

lines.zh: 我们围成半圈，缺口朝着坟地。
lines.en: We form a half circle, the gap toward the graves.

lines.zh: 我的手举着，等第一声骨头响。
lines.en: My hand is raised, waiting for the first bone to crack.

lines.zh: 你举火把，我们就往阴影里退。
lines.en: You raise a torch; we fade into the shadows.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头会看见更多。
lines.en: Do not look back; looking back shows you more.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，是为了不惊动你。
lines.en: I move slowly so as not to startle you.

lines.zh: 土里的手已经抓住你的脚跟。
lines.en: A hand in the soil has your heel already.

lines.zh: 你听不见我们呼吸，我们不呼吸。
lines.en: You hear no breathing, because we do not breathe.

lines.zh: 三面都有人，第四面是墓碑。
lines.en: Three sides closed; the fourth is a wall of headstones.

lines.zh: 我把手搭在墓碑上，慢慢起身。
lines.en: I rest a hand on a gravestone and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 你绕到东边，那边也有我们。
lines.en: You go east; we are there too.

lines.zh: 雾把我的脚藏住了。
lines.en: The mist hides my feet.

lines.zh: 你砍空了，我们往后退了一步。
lines.en: You swing at air; we step back as one.

lines.zh: 我一爪划过你的手臂，皮先开了。
lines.en: My claws cross your arm and the skin parts first.

lines.zh: 你砍在我肩上，我只歪了歪头。
lines.en: Your sword hits my shoulder; I only tilt my head.

lines.zh: 三只扑上来，你只能挡住一面。
lines.en: Three lunge; you can guard only one side.

lines.zh: 我的拳头不快，可落在身上很沉。
lines.en: My fist is slow but lands heavy.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬住你的护腕，咯咯作响。
lines.en: My teeth clamp your bracer and grind.

lines.zh: 三点护甲顶着你的剑，我不退。
lines.en: Three points of armor meet your blade; I do not yield.

lines.zh: 你后退，脚踩到了另一只的手。
lines.en: You step back onto another one's hand.

lines.zh: 我抓你的喉咙，你偏了半寸。
lines.en: I go for your throat; you turn half an inch.

lines.zh: 血溅在我脸上，我不擦。
lines.en: Blood spatters my face; I do not wipe it.

lines.zh: 这一下不算狠，下一只更狠。
lines.en: That blow was mild; the next one is worse.

lines.zh: 我被砍断一条手臂，还在往前。
lines.en: I lose an arm and keep coming.

lines.zh: 你喘了，我们没有。
lines.en: You are gasping; we are not.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，要砍很多下才够。
lines.en: Twenty health; it takes many cuts to finish.

lines.zh: 我倒下时，手还抓着你的披风。
lines.en: As I fall, my hand still grips your cloak.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣进你的领口。
lines.en: My fingers hook into your collar.

lines.zh: 你劈在我胸口，我只晃了晃。
lines.en: Your blade bites my chest; I only sway.

lines.zh: 夜一落下来，坟土就松了。
lines.en: When night falls, the grave soil loosens.

lines.zh: 我从土里坐起，先吐出嘴里的泥。
lines.en: I sit up out of the dirt and spit out mud.

lines.zh: 第二只第三只，土包一个个鼓起。
lines.en: A second, a third; the mounds swell one by one.

lines.zh: 月光不够亮，可我们不需要看。
lines.en: Moonlight is thin, but we need no light.

lines.zh: 亡魂在碑间飘，我们在下面站齐。
lines.en: Wraiths drift between stones; we line up below.

lines.zh: 这片墓园今夜归军团管。
lines.en: This graveyard belongs to the legion tonight.

lines.zh: 我拍了拍身上的土，没拍干净。
lines.en: I brush the soil off and fail to brush it off.

lines.zh: 有活人的味道，比往常浓。
lines.en: The smell of the living is stronger than usual.

lines.zh: 我从棺材缝里挤出，木板裂了。
lines.en: I squeeze out through the coffin seam; the plank splits.

lines.zh: 三十只就这么齐了，不用谁下令。
lines.en: Thirty of us assemble without a single order.

lines.zh: 天边还黑着，时间够用。
lines.en: The horizon is still dark; there is time.

lines.zh: 我推开上一具尸体，占了它的位置。
lines.en: I shove the last corpse aside and take its place.

lines.zh: 土里很闷，出来先站一会儿。
lines.en: The soil was stifling; I stand a while after emerging.

lines.zh: 破土的声音，就是我到的声音。
lines.en: The sound of breaking soil is the sound of my arrival.

lines.zh: 阳光还没来，火先来了，皮在卷。
lines.en: The sun has not come, but fire has; my skin curls.

lines.zh: 从坟头摔下，骨头散了三根。
lines.en: I fall off a grave mound and three bones come loose.

lines.zh: 水灌进胸腔，我从里面沉下去。
lines.en: Water fills my chest and I sink from within.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀散，零件落了一地。
lines.en: The blast scatters me; pieces land everywhere.

lines.zh: 箭穿过肋骨，卡在后面那根上。
lines.en: An arrow passes my ribs and sticks in the next bone.

lines.zh: 圣光落下来，我的骨头开始发白。
lines.en: Holy light falls and my bones turn white.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可身体还是在空下去。
lines.en: I eat nothing, yet I keep going hollow.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，骨头里全是蓝光。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me; blue light fills my bones.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: No soil in the void; I cannot grip anything.
